facts.fact: El Watan reports that Egypt's Public Prosecution ordered a Mansoura student held in custody pending investigation for fabricating an indecent AI-generated video of a female classmate, after a police complaint dated 28 May 2025.

EGY.note: Document states no government use of AI.
Document states no AI tool in a sector's public system.
Document states no AI built or hosted in the country.
Document states nothing on how stations record reports digitally.
